title: GHOST MAZE
oneLiner: Race through the haunted maze while a hungry ghost closes in!
mechanics: Move through a single-screen maze collecting glowing keys.
The ghost relentlessly follows your path and touching it costs a life.
Collect all keys to score and open the exit.
The ghost speeds up and extra dead ends appear as time passes.

controls.a: Drop a brief decoy at your position

lose: You lose when the ghost catches you.
scoring: Each key scores points, with a bonus for escaping the maze.
